evals.prompt: I just ran /researcher on 'Why most creators quit before 1000 subscribers' and got a research brief. Ready to write hooks now. /hook
evals.expected_output: The skill identifies the topic from context (or asks if unclear), confirms platform/format defaults, runs the Python command, reports the vault path, previews the starred recommended hook's Spoken Line, and suggests running /outline next with the hook-path flag.
expectations: The skill confirms the topic before running (either picked from context or asked)
The confirmation message includes platform and format defaults
The skill invokes python -m skills.hook with the topic argument
After completion, the vault file path is reported (Content-Hub-Vault-V2/05-Hooks/...)
The recommended hook's Spoken Line is previewed
The next-step prompt suggests /outline with the --hook-path flag

evals.prompt: /hook "The one editing trick that 3x'd my watch time" --platform yt-shorts --format short --audience "beginner YouTubers aged 18-30"
evals.expected_output: The skill parses all explicit flags (platform=yt-shorts, format=short, custom audience), confirms the command before running, invokes the Python script with all flags correctly, and delivers the vault output with the recommended hook.
expectations: The confirmation message echoes back the correct topic
The confirmation message shows platform=yt-shorts and format=short
The Python command includes --platform yt-shorts and --format short
The Python command includes the custom --audience value
After completion, the vault file path is reported
The recommended hook's Spoken Line is previewed

evals.prompt: Those hooks feel too safe and generic. Regenerate with more of a shock/pain-first angle, skip the polish pass to keep it fast. /hook "Why your AI content gets zero traction" --no-polish
evals.expected_output: The skill handles the re-run request (possibly acknowledging the regeneration intent), adds --no-polish to the command, runs again, and delivers a new vault file. Ideally surfaces which Kallaway patterns lean toward shock/pain (patterns 9 and 10).
expectations: The skill runs with --no-polish flag in the Python command
The confirmation message notes the --no-polish / fast mode
A new vault output file is reported (different path or acknowledged as re-run)
The recommended hook's Spoken Line is previewed
